name: Bangladesh National Institute of Education
description: বাংলাদেশ জাতীয় শিক্ষা ইনস্টিটিউট (BNIE) — Bangladesh National Institute of Education is a Government Approved Autonomous Institution offering certified Bachelor (BBA - 126 Credits, Honours), Degree Pass, Masters, 1-Year to 4-Year Polytechnic Diplomas, and SSC/HSC certifications with centralized online verification in Bangladesh.
